text:
emma: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the API instability earlier — I sketched proposed remediation -> test handoffs. Need owners and ETA so we can track in the postmortem checklist.

emma: Proposed items:
• Add regression prompt set (captures the failing prompt patterns + edge cases)
• Add k6 load scenario for short-lived KV spikes (replay incident shape)
• Add a targeted chaos drill for canary routing + autoscale during bursts
• Wire eval alerts for quality regressions on the prompt set

raj: I can own the regression prompt set. Quick q: do we want the prompts in the eval repo or in a shared prompts service? Prefer eval repo for now so CI picks it up.

emma: eval repo is fine — we want immediate CI coverage. Can you do a PR titled ml/evals/incident-171850-regression and add a small curated prompt set + a few golden outputs? ETA?

raj: ETA Apr 2. PR name and files: ml/evals/regressions/incident_171850/*.json. I'll include 8-10 prompts and a short harness that marks nondeterministic fields.

maya: I'll add the metric hooks for the new prompt set — thinking precision@k for key behaviors and a regression alert if it drops >4% in a 24h window. Need the prompt IDs from raj to wire alerts.

derek: I'll take load scenario. Plan: add scripts/k6/kv_spike.js with a 5m burst + 2m cool-down pattern to emulate the incident. We should run it nightly on the staging cluster and once a week against the canary region. Command: 

```
k6 run -u 50 -d 5m scripts/kv_spike.js
```

derek: ETA Apr 5 for script + CI job. Will add a job in infra-k8s/jenkinsfiles/ci-load.yml.

amanda: I'll own the chaos drill and runbook updates. Can we schedule a 2-hour drill with infra + oncall + ml on Apr 12? I’ll draft the playbook changes (how to detect falling KV hitrates, rollback plan, and quickest fallback to cold-start policy).

emma: Good. That leaves eval alert automation and dashboarding. Maya + Raj coordinate on prompt IDs; Maya + SRE to add dashboard panels.

maya: noted. Raj — ping me with the prompt IDs when you open the PR. For the alert I’ll create an alert rule: namespace=ml.evals, metric=prompt_precision, window=24h, threshold=-4%. Alert targets #eng-oncall and #eng-ml-evals.

raj: Will do. Also adding a short example entry for the eval JSON to make integration easy:

```
{
  "id": "incident_171850_prompt_01",
  "prompt": "User asks for long streaming summary and intermittently drops tokens",
  "expected_behavior": "should gracefully resume or return consistent partials",
  "golden": "<short example output>"
}
```

emma: Action items recap (I'll paste into the postmortem checklist):
• raj — regression prompt set + PR (due 2026-04-02)
• derek — k6 load scenario + CI job (due 2026-04-05)
• maya — eval metric + alert + dashboard (due 2026-04-07)
• amanda — chaos drill + runbook updates (exercise on 2026-04-12)

emma: Owners — please confirm and add any blockers. I'll add these to the postmortem and set recurring follow-ups weekly until closed.

raj: Confirmed, no blockers from my side.

derek: Confirmed, will need a short time window in staging to run the first burst (requesting 30m on Apr 6 for validation).

maya: Confirmed. One ask: can SRE provide one example trace from the incident to help set golden failure modes?

amanda: Will attach the trace to the postmortem doc by EOD today.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync for these action items on 2026-03-29 10:00 UTC in #eng-ml.

emma: Thanks all — I'll update the checklist and mark the postmortem as 'remediation-in-progress'. If any owner slips, please ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
